### Classified finding kinds (headline)
- account changed at fixed position (~49)
- FIELD changed (~30)
- arg changed / new / removed
- account removed / instruction removed
- Dangerous: new account on instruction (min-accounts)
- Additive: cancelDustOrder + cancelDustOrderEvent
